Card Q&A.q: Can I use  to digivolve my Digimon if I activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect and end the attack from an opponent's Digimon?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may trash up to 3 blue cards from your hand. For each card trashed by this effect, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers and trash it. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers without cards under it can't suspend until the end of your opponent's turn.
[Opponent's Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks, end that attack by returning 3 cards with [Jellymon] in their text from your trash to the bottom of your deck.
